name: emoji-reaction

frames.best_why: No image exists for this component.

tagline: Pill reaction bar with emoji, rolling counts and a particle burst.
summary: A row of rounded reaction pills, each holding an emoji and a count. Clicking toggles your reaction, rolls the number like an odometer and fires a small particle burst, with an optional picker for more emoji.
appearance: A horizontal row of rounded pill buttons, each with an emoji on the left and a number on the right, outlined with a thin border; a reacted pill sits slightly darker and inset. The optional picker adds a round smile-plus button and a small floating card of emoji above it.
behaviour: Clicking a pill toggles the reaction: the count rolls to the new number, the emoji pops, and a ring with dots bursts outward. Hovering or clicking the picker button opens a small menu of extra reactions that can be stepped through from the keyboard.
demo_content: Heart 24, rocket 12 (reacted), clap 7 and laugh 3 under a launch post by Priya Nair.
use_when: A post, comment or message needs lightweight emoji reactions with visible counts and a quick extra-emoji picker.
avoid_when: The burst and odometer are pure polish; on very dense feeds they add motion and cost without helping.
customise: Reactions come as an array of emoji, label, count and reacted; size, multiple mode, burst count, picker emojis and visibility are props, while colours follow the theme.
weight_why: A handful of DOM pills and motion particles that exist only while reacting.

a11y.note: Pills are labelled with their emoji and count, use aria-pressed, and the picker is a proper menu; reduced motion is respected.

polish_why: No frames to judge; from the code it looks a competent, themed reaction bar.
title: Emoji Reaction
